rule: incident = assertion_type in (confirmed_incident, third_party_claim); Nouvelle-Aquitaine = event.regional or the linked org department is one of the 12 NA codes; language = exclusive function-word and strong-phrase scoring on title + summary, undetermined on ties or fewer than two word hits, non-French requires confidence >= 0.25

sql.incidents:
SELECT e.id::text AS id, e.title, e.summary, e.assertion_type, e.regional,
         o.dept AS department, e.source_id
    FROM event e
    LEFT JOIN org o ON o.id = e.org_id
   WHERE e.assertion_type IN ('confirmed_incident', 'third_party_claim')
     AND (e.regional OR o.dept IN ('16', '17', '19', '23', '24', '33', '40', '47', '64', '79', '86', '87'))
   ORDER BY e.id
sql.baseline:
SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM source) AS sources,
         (SELECT count(*)::int FROM event) AS events
